chunks: Whatever is in it from Idrīs ibn Hilāl, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī Mājīlawayh — may Allah be pleased with him — from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā al-ʿAṭṭār, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Idrīs ibn Hilāl.

key_terms.الْعَطَّارِ: Al-ʿAṭṭār; a recognized nisbah within the transmission chain
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: May Allah be pleased with him; an honorific supplication for the narrator
key_terms.عَنْ إِدْرِيسَ بْنِ هِلَالٍ: From Idrīs ibn Hilāl; the named transmitter to whom this chain leads
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; a statement identifying the author’s line of transmission

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Idrīs ibn Hilāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage gives the sanad/isnad for reports transmitted from Idrīs ibn Hilāl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the route of transmission through named narrators back to Idrīs ibn Hilāl.
